title: JSON Schema for Umbraco package Our.Umbraco.TagHelpers

EnsureViewBox.description: Enables the feature to 'fix' the output SVG which always ensures the SVG utilises a viewbox rather than width & height

Cache.description: Enables the feature to cache the output at runtime level

CacheMinutes.description: Defines the amount of time (in minutes) to cache the output. To be used in conjunction with the cache property

ScopeStyles.description: Scopes each inlined SVG's <style> blocks to that SVG, so class names such as .st0 from two SVGs on one page don't restyle each other

UniqueIds.description: Gives the ids in each inlined SVG a prefix of their own and updates the references to them, so SVGs on one page don't share gradients, clip paths or filters

MobileFirst.description: Alternates between min-width & max-width media queries. When enabled, min-width is used.

UseNativeLazyLoading.description: If enabled, loading='true' is used. If disabled, the 'src' property is replaced with 'data-src' which most lazy loading JavaScript libraries will interpret and lazy load the image.

LazyLoadCssClass.description: If 'UseNativeLazyLoading' is disabled, the class property is given an additional class for JavaScript libraries to target. Note: 'lazyload' is used by the lazysizes library.

LazyLoadPlaceholder.description: TODO: Think can only be SVG or LowQualityImage

LazyLoadPlaceholderLowQualityImageQualit.description: If 'UseNativeLazyLoading' is disabled and 'LazyLoadPlaceholder' is 'LowQualityImage', what image quality should be rendered. Numeric values 1-100 accepted.

ApplyAspectRatio.description: If enabled, the aspect-ratio CSS style is applied to the style property, and the width & height properties are removed.

AlternativeTextMediaTypePropertyAlias.description: The media property alias to pull through the alt text value. If not found, the media title or filename will be used instead.

Small.description: Width in pixels for small breakpoint

Medium.description: Width in pixels for medium breakpoint

Large.description: Width in pixels for large breakpoint

ExtraLarge.description: Width in pixels for extra large breakpoint

ExtraExtraLarge.description: Width in pixels for extra extra large breakpoint

RootFolder.description: The folder locaton to store the self hosted assets in

AllowedHosts.description: Hosts that files may be downloaded from, e.g. "unpkg.com". Empty (the default) allows any host; a URL on another host keeps pointing at the original.

MaxFileSizeKilobytes.description: The largest file that's downloaded, in kilobytes (1024 = 1 MB). Larger files keep the original URL; raise it to self host bigger files such as large images.

DownloadTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a download, in seconds. A slower download keeps the original URL.
